## Merge Workflow

**Purpose**: n8n workflow: Merge Workflow. 10 nodes. Uses: functionItem, hubspot, zendesk, cron, stopAndError. Sourced from czlonkowski/Zie619 n8n-workflows community archive (workflows/Zendesk/0285_Zendesk_HubSpot_Create_Scheduled.json). Configure credentials and any hardcoded IDs before activating.

**Services needed**: functionItem, hubspot, zendesk, cron, stopAndError

**Difficulty**: 5min-config

**Setup**:
1. Configure credentials for the services above
2. Update any hardcoded IDs / URLs
3. Test with sample data before activating
